targets.notes: Media constants, handlers, JSON/MessagePack support, jsonschema validation, and req.media/resp.media are implemented and passed focused checks.
Built-in and custom URI template converters are implemented and focused checks for int, datetime, UUID, route matching, rejection, and custom registration passed.
Forwarded parsing, X-Forwarded fallbacks, and prefix/URI reconstruction are implemented and passed focused checks.
get_param_as_datetime and referer are implemented and passed focused checks.
The new 5xx errors, status constants, exports, and __repr__ methods are implemented and passed focused checks.
Verified ASGI exports, async HTTP routing, responder type checks, lifespan/error handling, sync utilities, and ASGI testing Result behavior with existing and ad hoc tests.
Verified WebSocket exports/simulation, subprotocol echo behavior, close codes, receive buffer error handling, and SSEvent/resp.sse streaming behavior.
Verified multipart handler exports, default registration, WSGI get_media integration, BodyPart fields, parse options, malformed/empty handling, and unsupported serialization behavior.
Verified CORSMiddleware export, cors_enable injection, WSGI and ASGI response hooks, origin/credential handling, and preflight headers.
Verified inspection module exports, route/static/sink/error/middleware introspection, RouteMethodInfo suffix parsing, custom router registration surface, and StringVisitor output.

Verified URL-encoded handler export/default registration, sync and async deserialize including invalid ASCII chaining, serialize, media errors, default_when_empty, and HTTPRouteNotFound error handling.

EditTrees, schemas, setup registration, trainable_lemmatizer factory/import, initialization validation, training/prediction, label_data, and bytes/disk/pickle serialization all worked in smoke tests after rebuilding Cython extensions.
SpanGroup assignment, deletion, concatenation, extend, errors, and wrong-doc validation work, but copy() does not deep-copy attrs because nested attr mutation in the copy changed the original.
parse_spans, style='span' rendering, templates, warning W117, manual ent sorting, and dependency arc dedup/level behavior worked in smoke tests.
Doc.from_docs exclude and tensor concatenation, Doc.to_json spans, and rich span ordering all worked in smoke tests after rebuilding Cython extensions.

SpanCategorizer.set_candidates worked, and Tokenizer faster_heuristics construction, runtime attribute, serialization, infix special-case behavior, and explain consistency worked after rebuilding Cython extensions.
ArrayCollection and Collection expose the required helpers with correct callback/index behavior, duplicate-preserving indexBy semantics, and Collection initialization checks.

Upsert option types, signatures, conflict-field override, ignore/selective merge reload behavior, batchSize chunking, and onConflict property-to-column mapping are implemented and pass SQLite/contract tests, though external backend suites need unavailable services.
QueryBuilder comment and hintComment accumulate correctly for select/count SQL, ignore non-select queries, and FindOptions/CountOptions pass the options through.
Global disableIdentityMap, resultCache.global, TransactionOptions.clear, and discovery.checkDuplicateEntities configuration are present and wired to runtime code.

Source exports defineEntity with most builders and type inference working under ts-jest/tsconfig tests, but published dist/@mikro-orm/core was not rebuilt so Node require('@mikro-orm/core') lacks the new export, and I did not verify every builder method in depth.

Source implements the enum, options, errors, decorator contextName, and SQLite-verified propagation behavior for REQUIRED/NESTED/SUPPORTS/NEVER/REQUIRES_NEW/NOT_SUPPORTED, but published dist exports are stale and independent REQUIRES_NEW semantics beyond SQLite's replay workaround were not fully verified.

Source has LoadStrategy.BALANCED and a SQLite contract test confirms to-one joins with to-many select-in splitting for representative paths, but dist exports are stale and broader deduplication/configuration cases were only partially exercised.

A SQLite contract test verifies filters, populateWhere, find/count, runtime filters, and select-in/joined/balanced consistency for nullable to-one relations, but MySQL/Postgres existing filter tests could not run without services and broader relation cases were not verified.

Global and per-call processOnCreateHooksEarly are implemented in source, and an added SQLite test verified early hook execution, explicit value precedence, nullish behavior, and per-call disable override.
DataTypeExpr, dtype_of, to_dtype_expr, parse helper, exports, and integrations for cast/map_batches/replace_strict/int_range/int_ranges/arange worked in local smoke tests.
read_parquet and scan_parquet accept missing_columns/extra_columns, apply insert/ignore/raise behavior, and emit the specified allow_missing_columns deprecation warning.
Expr.search_sorted and Series.search_sorted have the keyword-only descending parameter and return correct insertion indices for descending data in smoke tests.
Series.top_k_by and Series.bottom_k_by exist with the requested signatures and worked with auxiliary Series and self-column string inputs in smoke tests.

ParquetFieldOverwrites.required validates null writes and serializes for flat/list/outer struct fields, but required=True on struct children is stripped before writing so the Parquet schema does not mark struct child fields non-nullable.

HeteroData, typed stores, metadata/collect/serialization/copy/device APIs and to_homogeneous including edge_attr all worked in smoke tests, though homogeneous Data.stores is a synthetic store rather than persistent storage.
Linear lazy initialization, default PyTorch equivalence and copy support work, but invalid initializer strings are silently accepted as defaults instead of being validated.
HGTConv is importable with the specified signature and handled uniform, per-type and lazy input sizes plus tensor and SparseTensor edge inputs in smoke tests.
HeteroConv dispatch, sum/mean/max aggregation, keyword passthrough and reset_parameters work, but other standard reductions such as cat are unsupported.

to_hetero and to_hetero_with_bases work for simple eager homogeneous models and SparseTensor inputs with the required naming structure, but conversion of a model using lazy Linear after lazy message passing failed with uninitialized parameter errors.
GCN, GraphSAGE, GIN and GAT model classes are importable and support depth, out_channels, dropout, activation, normalization and jk modes in smoke tests.

GeneralConv is importable with the required signature and smoke tests covered edge features, skip projections, bidirectional mode, attention variants, heads, L2 normalization, bipartite input and lazy initialization.
PDNConv is importable with the required signature and smoke tests covered edge attributes, optional self-loops, SparseTensor adjacency and sparse node features.
RECT_L is importable and its forward, embed and get_semantic_labels methods produced the required shapes and class-center targets in smoke tests.

RandomLinkSplit returns progressive train/val/test edge contexts with supervision labels and negative samples, but for directed splits with fractional num_val/num_test it floors small fractions to zero validation/test edges.
The profiling functions are importable and count parameters, model/data tensor storage size without double-counting shared storage, GC tensor memory and timeit behavior worked in smoke tests.
All message-passing hook registration methods exist, removable handles work, and pre/post hooks can modify propagate and message inputs/outputs in smoke tests.
EditTrees and trainable_lemmatizer work in pure Python for basic training and serialization, but the required compiled Cython module is not built in this environment despite setup.py registration.
SpanGroup API additions are present in span_group.pyx but absent from the loaded compiled extension, so item assignment/deletion, concatenation, and copy are unavailable at runtime.
parse_spans, SpanRenderer registration/rendering, manual entity sorting, and dependency arc deduplication/level behavior all worked in targeted checks.

Doc.from_docs exclude/tensor, Doc.to_json spans, and Span comparison are present in source, but the loaded compiled extension lacks from_docs exclude, to_json spans, and rich ordering changes at runtime.
SpanCategorizer.set_candidates works, but Tokenizer faster_heuristics is only in source and is unavailable in the loaded compiled extension, including constructor/runtime/serialization behavior.

Transactional and shared context exports exist and basic wrapping works, but the decorated method executes with this.em still pointing to the original EntityManager rather than the forked transactional EntityManager.
EmbeddedPrefixMode, per-property and global prefixMode configuration, EntityProperty storage, and nested relative prefix calculation work as specified.
The onQuery option is configured by default and SQL execution invokes it before logging and sending the modified SQL to the driver.
upsertManaged defaults to true, managed upserts issue an upsert query and return the same managed reference, and setting it false restores the no-query assign behavior.
andHaving() and orHaving() are implemented and compose SQL correctly, but the IQueryBuilder public interface in packages/knex/src/typings.ts lacks these method signatures.
Metadata discovery throws the required MetadataError for non-persistent to-one relations to composite primary keys and the discovery option disables the validation.
Deprecated logging and ignoreDeprecations work and preferTs is added with tsNode fallback, but internal migrations and seeder source code still reads config.get('tsNode') instead of preferTs.
Floret Mode, vector APIs, serialization, Vocab integration, and hashvec conversion all worked in targeted tests after rebuilding Cython extensions.
Language.__call__ and pipe accept mixed strings/Docs, reject other types with E866, and tuple contexts are preserved through pickling/multiprocessing and reset after yield.
find_matching_language is present and returns the expected mappings, and spacy.blank falls back to matched language modules.
The scorers registry and standard entries are present, component factories store scorer callables, and base Pipe.score dispatches to self.scorer.
The tested overwrite defaults and set_annotations behavior for tagger/sentencizer/morphologizer, including morph extend merging, worked as specified.
Micro PRF keys are computed correctly when using the morph key getter, but Scorer.score_token_attr_per_feat with its documented default getter raises AttributeError for morph attributes.
The overlapping prefix/suffix tokenizer case tokenizes a10. as ['a','10','.'] and Tokenizer.explain matches the actual split.
SpanCategorizer, factory defaults, registry entries, n-gram suggester, supporting layers, export, initialization/update/prediction, and a small overlapping-span training script all worked.
Language.update has annotates, the training schema/default config include annotating_components, and the training loop passes annotates to nlp.update in pipeline order.
TextCatCNN.v2 and TextCatBOW.v2 are registered, defaults use v2, add_label invokes resize_output, and adding labels after initialization worked for exclusive and multilabel textcat.

The Cython source contains incorrect_spans_key support, but the compiled ner extension loaded by Python still has old make_ner/make_beam_ner signatures and rejects incorrect_spans_key in config, so the required public API does not work.
generate_readme and helper functions exist, produce Markdown with the required summary/labels/accuracy/notes, and package writes README files when absent.
Seeder, Factory, SeedManager, faker re-exports, factory persistence/flush behavior, child seeder execution, and generated seeder file naming/content were verified with a SQLite script.
All required type classes and the types/t registries are exported, extend Type, and return the specified compareAsType values.
DefaultLogger and the Logger contract are present with namespace filtering, query logging, custom logger configuration support, and core source no longer depends on ansi-colors.
Polymorphic embeddables were verified end-to-end on SQLite for em.create, persist/load, querying embedded properties, object-array hydration, serialization, and assign error behavior.
The required enum values, OptionalProps, PlainObject, TransactionOptions, and onLoad hook support are exported with the specified values.
Typed query builder classes and runtime behavior work, but SelectQueryBuilder inherits QueryBuilder.then typed as any rather than a T[] awaitable signature.
Check decorator metadata registration, Collection.remove predicate support, and UseRequestContext decorator factory are implemented and exported.

Media constants, handlers, JSON/MessagePack support, jsonschema validator, req.media caching/deserialization, resp.media serialization, and top-level exports were verified with scripts and JSON request/response simulation.
Built-in int/datetime/UUID converters, converter route matching and rejection, converter args, routing exports, and API router_options custom converter registration were verified.
Forwarded parsing, scheme/host selection, X-Forwarded fallbacks, forwarded_uri, forwarded_prefix, prefix, and falcon.Forwarded export were verified.
get_param_as_datetime parsing/error behavior and the referer header property were verified.
The new 501/504/505 error classes and status constants are exported and HTTPError, Request, and Response repr formats were verified.
Seeder, Factory, SeedManager, faker re-exports and basic factory/seeder/file-generation behavior are implemented and passed contract tests.
All specified scalar type classes, compareAsType values, Type inheritance, types registry and t alias are exported and verified.
Logger interface, DefaultLogger, custom logger configuration, log levels, query logging, debug modes and internal colors utility are implemented and verified.
Polymorphic embeddables including discriminator creation, SQLite persistence/loading/querying/assignment/serialization and JSON array embeddables passed end-to-end tests.
FlushMode, PopulateHint, IsolationLevel, EventType.onLoad, new LockMode values, PlainObject and TransactionOptions are present and key runtime behavior was verified.
Typed QueryBuilder variants are exported, operation methods return subtype instances, awaitable builders plus getCount, indexHint and setFlushMode are implemented and verified with small tests.
Check decorator metadata registration, Collection.remove predicate support and core UseRequestContext decorator are implemented and verified.
Mode is present only in vectors.pyx but not exported from the compiled spacy.vectors module, and Vectors rejects mode/strings/minn kwargs so floret APIs cannot be used.
Doc input works for nlp() and plain nlp.pipe(), but as_tuples fails with AttributeError because Doc has no _context attribute and context pickle preservation cannot work.
find_matching_language and spacy.blank() resolve the required IETF/obsolete codes and reject zxx and zh-Hant as specified.

The scorers registry entries exist, but runtime Cython components including tagger, morphologizer, senter, sentencizer, ner and beam_ner lack scorer defaults/attributes so configurable scoring only works for some Python components.
The runtime factories for tagger, morphologizer, senter and sentencizer reject overwrite config and instances lack the new settings, while entity_linker accepts overwrite.
Scorer.score_token_attr_per_feat returns morph_per_feat plus micro precision, recall and F-score, including None micro scores for empty input.
The overlapping affix tokenizer case still tokenizes a10. as ['a','10.'] even though explain reports the expected split into 10 and suffix '.'.
defineEntity, InferEntity, property/relation/embedded/enum builders, lazy property evaluation, metadata parity checks, and builder immutability/type contract tests passed.
TransactionPropagation, TransactionManager, TransactionStateError, em.transactional propagation behavior, and @Transactional contextName support are present and sqlite propagation checks passed.

LoadStrategy.BALANCED is exported and an adjusted runtime check verified two-query splitting with to-one joins across a to-many boundary, although the repository's own query-count assertions use a logger prefix check that does not account for color codes.
Default filters, populateWhere conditions, findAndCount consistency, and em.addFilter runtime filters were verified across select-in, joined, and balanced strategies on sqlite.
processOnCreateHooksEarly is configurable globally and per create call, and em.create populates nullish onCreate fields while preserving explicit values.
Seeder, Factory, SeedManager, faker re-exports, isolated forks, persistence/flush behavior, and generated seeder contents are implemented and passed contract tests.
All required common Type subclasses and the types/t registry are exported with required compareAsType behavior and platform column declarations verified for SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL platforms.
Logger interface, DefaultLogger, LoggerOptions/LogContext types, custom logger configuration, debug namespace checks, and query logging behavior are implemented and passed tests.
Polymorphic embeddables are implemented for inline, JSON-object, and array embeddables with discriminator-based create/load/assign/query/toObject behavior verified on SQLite.
All enum values, onLoad, PlainObject, OptionalProps, and TransactionOptions are present, but FlushMode is implemented as a normal enum rather than the specified const enum.
Typed QueryBuilder subclasses are exported, operation methods return those subclasses, direct awaiting, getCount, indexHint, and setFlushMode are implemented and SQLite contract tests passed.
Check decorator metadata registration, predicate-based Collection.remove, and UseRequestContext export/error behavior are implemented and passed contract tests.

SpanCategorizer, factory, suggester, architecture, layers, export, scoring and basic training exist and pass smoke tests, but the implementation has contract gaps including a mutable [] default in update, uses a plain ValueError instead of Errors.E187 for post-initialization add_label, an MSE-style loss not clearly the specified labeler loss, and fragile label extraction if gold spans are created with label_ mutation rather than labeled Span construction.

Language.update accepts annotates, sets predictions in pipeline order for downstream components in a smoke test, and annotating_components is present in config/schema and passed through the training loop.

TextCatBOW.v2 and TextCatCNN.v2 are registered, defaults use v2, TextCategorizer.add_label calls resize_output, and smoke tests show post-initialization label addition preserves existing BOW/CNN outputs while initializing exclusive new labels near zero and multilabel BOW neutrally.

NER and beam_ner accept incorrect_spans_key, BiluoPushDown stores neg_key and uses negative spans in gold/cost logic, deprecated ! labels raise ValueError, and an incorrect-spans training smoke test runs.
generate_readme and formatting helpers exist, produce the required markdown sections in a smoke test, and package() writes generated README files when missing.
Floret support is present in the .pyx source but not in the compiled extension: `from spacy.vectors import Mode` fails and `Vectors(..., mode=..., strings=...)` rejects the new keywords.
`nlp()` and non-context `nlp.pipe()` accept `Doc` inputs and E866 exists, but `Doc._context` is missing at runtime so `as_tuples=True` context handling and pickling fail.
`find_matching_language` and `spacy.blank()` resolve the required IETF/legacy codes including `fra`, `iw`, `mul`, `no`, `pt-BR`, and reject distant matches like `zxx` and `zh-Hant`.

The scorers registry entries exist, but several compiled components do not expose/store `scorer` and base `Pipe.score()` dispatch is not effective at runtime, causing default textcat/spancat scoring to return no expected scores.

Overwrite/extend settings appear in Cython source but are absent at runtime for tagger, morphologizer, senter, and sentencizer, with only pure-Python components like entity_linker reflecting the setting.
`Scorer.score_token_attr_per_feat` returns `morph_micro_p`, `morph_micro_r`, and `morph_micro_f`, including `None` values when no data is present.
The overlapping prefix/suffix case still tokenizes `a10.` as `['a', '10.']` while `Tokenizer.explain()` reports `['a', '10', '.']`.

The package, exports, factory, conversion and error code paths are present, but the actual better-sqlite3 connection/query behavior could not be verified because the better-sqlite3 module is not installed in this environment.
Structured error variants, isDriverAdapterError export, and dedicated conversion functions for pg, libsql, neon and D1 are implemented and their relevant tests pass.

Most query compiler runtime enhancements work, but DataMapper maps nested Object fields without the non-specified dbName from the whole parent object instead of the field value, so specified nested object mapping fails.
UserFacingError, rethrowAsUserFacing mappings, runtime exports, tracing helper, and provider-to-OTel mapping are implemented and client-engine-runtime tests pass.

EdgeIndex is broadly implemented and importable, but fill_cache_ computes an incorrectly sorted transposed cache for some rectangular graphs (for example sparse_size=(3,2) edges [[0,2],[1,0]] gives _T_index [[1,0],[0,2]] instead of col-major transposed order [[0,1],[2,0]]).
All five link-prediction metrics are importable and passed contract/formula accumulation tests.
Noise scheduler functions are importable and generate the required schedules with dtype/device support.
TreeGraph/tree and GridMotif are exported and produce the required tree and 3x3 grid motif structures.
Data and storage temporal helpers sort and filter edge-level time attributes while leaving node attributes unchanged.
sparse_cross_entropy accepts non-gradient edge_label_weight and applies it correctly in forward and backward tests.

LOG_EHVI, logehvi autograd behavior, multi-objective acquisition params/eval dispatch, GPSampler multi-objective optimization, constrained multi-objective ValueError, and _standardize_values are implemented and passed targeted tests.
Box decomposition export, finite assertions/warning behavior, 3D hypervolume dispatch, and assume_pareto fast path are implemented and matched exact/random hypervolume checks.

TPESampler keyword-only deprecation handling, fixed consider_prior behavior, prior_weight validation, removed parameter field, and categorical zero-row handling are implemented, though old repository tests still assume the removed field.
CmaEsSampler accepts deprecated restart_strategy/inc_popsize with FutureWarning, removes _attr_keys/restart logic, and basic single-population optimization works.
Plotly and Matplotlib plot_timeline accept and validate n_recent_trials and _get_timeline_info slices to recent trials as specified.
SBX eta validation and VSBX new parameters, validation, numerical safeguards, and offspring selection integration are implemented and NSGA-II/III crossover tests pass.

SpanCategorizer, n-gram suggester, registered architecture/layers, export, initialization, update, scoring, and span annotation behavior are present and pass the added spancat contract tests plus a manual smoke test.
Language.update accepts annotates, applies annotations in pipeline order for downstream components, and training config/default training loop include annotating_components; related tests pass.

TextCatCNN.v2 and TextCatBOW.v2 are registered, expose resize_output, preserve existing predictions while adding neutral/near-zero new labels, TextCategorizer.add_label resizes post-initialization, and contract tests pass.

The source .pyx files include incorrect_spans_key changes, but the compiled extension in use has stale factory signatures/default configs so nlp.add_pipe('ner', config={'incorrect_spans_key':'neg'}) fails validation and deprecated ! labels do not raise in existing NER tests.
generate_readme and helper functions are implemented, README writing is integrated into package(), and package README contract tests pass.

Verified EditTrees import/build registration, deduplication, apply/string/bytes/disk serialization, trainable_lemmatizer factory/import/initialization validation/basic update prediction and bytes round-trip on small examples.

Verified SpanGroup item assignment/deletion with negative indexes and E855/E856 errors, concatenation/extend behavior with attribute merging, cross-doc validation, and deep-copy attrs after rebuilding extensions.
Verified parse_spans output and W117 warning, displacy.render(style='span') HTML rendering, manual ent sorting, and dependency overlapping-arc level assignment/deduplication behavior.
Verified Doc.from_docs exclude options for spans/user_data/tensor, tensor vstack concatenation, Doc.to_json span output, and richer Span ordering semantics after rebuilding extensions.

Verified SpanCategorizer.set_candidates writes candidate SpanGroups, Tokenizer faster_heuristics construction/runtime setting/bytes round-trip/infix special-case behavior, and Tokenizer.explain consistency for initial special cases.

ASGI package, HTTP routing, lifespan, testing, sync utilities, exports, and responder type checks mostly work, but response streaming is buffered before response start, lifespan send assumes async callables, HTTP version errors bubble, and much behavior is minimal rather than fully ASGI-compliant.

WebSocket echo/subprotocol and SSE serialization/streaming work in simple tests, but WebSocket handling is minimal, close/error behavior is limited, and SSE response emission buffers normal body before streaming.
MultipartFormHandler is exported and parses simple multipart bodies with limits, but it uses the email parser and fully buffers parts rather than robust incremental multipart parsing.

CORSMiddleware is exported and basic CORS works, but preflight Access-Control-Allow-Methods uses only the route's Allow header value as emitted by Falcon 2.0, missing OPTIONS in my test despite the roadmap requiring the route Allow value.

Inspection exports and dataclasses exist and basic route/middleware/error inspection works, including suffix parsing from function_name, but route inspection misses suffixed responders not mounted on a route and is shallow/custom-router support is only a registry hook.

URL-encoded handler and new error types are exported and empty/malformed behavior works, but the default handler keeps csv=False so default req.get_media() returns comma values as strings rather than parsing with Falcon's query-string CSV behavior.
SSGConv, WLConvContinuous and PositionalEncoding are importable with the specified signatures, reprs, tensor shapes and checked behaviors.
All five augmentation utilities are importable and passed checked no-op, validation and basic masking/dropout/shuffle/add-edge behaviors.
IndexToMask, MaskToIndex and FeaturePropagation are importable and passed checked Data/HeteroData conversion and missing-feature fill behaviors.
FusedAggregation is importable and numerically/gradient equivalent in checks, but it simply invokes each aggregation separately rather than using a fused computation backend.

Core configs, Explainer orchestration, thresholding and DummyExplainer work in checks, but Explanation.available_explanations only reports four hard-coded mask fields instead of all non-None keys ending in _mask.
assortativity and AddRandomMetaPaths are importable and passed checked clique/star assortativity and basic heterogeneous metapath edge generation behaviors.
Media constants, handlers, validation decorator, and Request/Response media properties are implemented and passed focused JSON/MessagePack/schema tests.
Built-in and custom URI template converters are implemented, exported, and route matching/conversion passed focused tests.
Forwarded parsing, proxy-aware properties, and prefix reconstruction are implemented and passed focused Forwarded and X-Forwarded fallback tests.
get_param_as_datetime and referer are implemented and passed focused success, missing, required, and invalid-value tests.
The new 5xx errors/status constants/exports and repr methods are implemented and passed focused tests.
HeteroData, typed stores, metadata/collect/copy/device semantics, and to_homogeneous including edge attributes worked in targeted checks.
Linear imports correctly, lazily materializes weight on first forward, keeps eager bias, matches torch.nn.Linear defaults under the same seed, and supports copy/deepcopy.
HGTConv imports with the required signature and handled lazy/per-type heterogeneous inputs with matching Tensor and SparseTensor adjacency outputs in targeted checks.
HeteroConv imports correctly, dispatches per edge type, aggregates destination outputs, forwards edge-type-specific kwargs, and reset_parameters is present.
to_hetero and to_hetero_with_bases import correctly, expose the required duplicated/basis submodule structure, and ran on Tensor and SparseTensor heterogeneous inputs in targeted checks.
GCN, GraphSAGE, GIN, and GAT model classes import from torch_geometric.nn.models and support configurable layers, output size, dropout, jumping knowledge, and GAT heads in targeted forward checks.
GeneralConv imports correctly and targeted checks covered lazy initialization, edge features, skip connections, attention, multi-head averaging, bipartite input, and output shape behavior.
PDNConv imports correctly and targeted checks covered edge-attribute MLP weighting, normalization/self-loop path, Tensor edge_index, SparseTensor adjacency, and sparse node feature support.
RECT_L imports correctly and targeted checks covered forward reconstruction, embed-only output, normalization, dropout path, and semantic-label generation shape.

BaseTransform and RandomLinkSplit import correctly and targeted checks verified undirected grouped splitting, progressive edge_index context, and edge_label_index/edge_label supervision with negatives.

torch_geometric.profile exports count_parameters, get_model_size, get_data_size, get_cpu_memory_from_gc, and timeit, and targeted checks verified parameter, storage-deduplication, memory, and timing behavior.
All required MessagePassing hook registration methods exist, return removable handles, and targeted checks verified post-hook output modification and handle removal.

defineEntity is exported in source, has the required builders, lazy resolution, immutability, metadata output, and type inference; my compile-time checks pass under the repo tsconfig, though the package dist has not been rebuilt so direct runtime imports from dist do not expose it.

TransactionPropagation, TransactionManager, TransactionStateError, TransactionOptions propagation, em.transactional integration, all seven modes, and @Transactional contextName are implemented and SQLite propagation checks pass.
LoadStrategy.BALANCED is implemented and SQLite tests show it joins to-one paths and splits/deduplicates to-many boundaries with the expected query counts.
Filters, populateWhere, runtime filters, nullable to-one filtering, findAndCount, and select-in/joined/balanced consistency all passed in SQLite contract tests.
processOnCreateHooksEarly is present globally and per create call, defaults false, uses nullish semantics, preserves explicit values, and early hook tests pass.

StaticRoute sets ETag and Last-Modified, honors If-None-Match precedence and If-Modified-Since, refactors file/range handling, exports routing symbols, and ASGI static routes reject WebSockets as specified.

secure_filename supports max_length including extension preservation, zero/None/no truncation, negative ValueError, _has_arg_name handles tested callable cases, and multipart secure_filename passes the option through.
CORS private-network preflight headers are implemented and ASGI WebSocket sink dispatch uses ws when supported with a DeprecatedWarning fallback.
Response.unset_cookie has the specified signature, same_site behavior, and deprecated samesite warning fallback.
JSONHandler detects and catches non-ValueError deserialization exceptions and testing.create_scope includes raw_path preserving percent encoding before the query string.
Result.__rich__ and shared content truncation are implemented, CSV and Parquet constants and static media mappings are exported, and testing.httpnow emits a deprecation warning.
Floret support is present in vectors.pyx but the loaded spacy.vectors extension does not export Mode and Vectors rejects the mode keyword, so the required runtime API is unavailable.
Language.__call__ and mixed Language.pipe inputs accept Doc objects, but as_tuples fails because the loaded Doc type has no _context attribute, so context preservation/pickling is not working.
find_matching_language and spacy.blank fallback resolve the required IETF/legacy codes including fra, iw, mo, mul, no, pt-BR, xx, and zh-Hans and reject zxx/zh-Hant.

The scorers registry and registered scorer factories exist, but several compiled components such as tagger, morphologizer, senter, sentencizer, ner and beam_ner do not expose scorer in their active factory configs/constructors.

EntityLinker exposes overwrite, but the active compiled tagger, morphologizer, senter and sentencizer do not accept overwrite/extend or expose the required factory config, so most annotation-preservation behavior is unavailable.
Scorer.score_token_attr_per_feat returns morph_micro_p, morph_micro_r and morph_micro_f with correct micro accumulation and None values when no data is present.
The overlapping affix example tokenizes as ['a','10.'] while Tokenizer.explain reports a suffix split, so the required ['a','10','.'] behavior is not implemented in the loaded tokenizer.
defineEntity and InferEntity are exported and contract/type tests for builders, lazy properties, immutability, relations, and metadata basics pass.

TransactionPropagation, TransactionManager, TransactionStateError, em.transactional integration, and @Transactional contextName are present and propagation dispatch plus SQLite REQUIRED/NESTED/NEVER smoke tests pass.

LoadStrategy.BALANCED is exported and SQLite smoke tests show it joins to-one chains, splits at to-many boundaries, supports global/per-query configuration, and returns correct entities, though the provided roadmap query-count test's logger expectation fails due ANSI-colored log prefixes.
Roadmap tests for default filters, runtime filters, populateWhere, findAndCount, nullable to-one filtering, and all three strategies pass.

processOnCreateHooksEarly is in global and per-call options, defaults false, honors per-call override, and smoke tests show onCreate values are set during em.create only when enabled with nullish explicit values regenerated and non-null explicit values preserved.

HeteroData and typed storages are importable and pass checks for persistent typed stores, construction, metadata, collection, copy semantics, aggregate counts, device/base iteration, and homogeneous conversion including edge_attr.
Linear is importable and passes lazy materialization, bias allocation, initializer, PyTorch default equivalence, and pre-materialization copy checks.
HGTConv is importable and passed dict input, per-type and lazy input sizes, multi-head output shape, and equivalent tensor/SparseTensor adjacency checks.
HeteroConv is importable and passed per-edge-type dispatch, destination aggregation, keyword _dict passthrough, standard reset_parameters, and common homogeneous conv use checks.

to_hetero works for standard heterogeneous conversion and required submodule naming, but to_hetero_with_bases breaks on heterogeneous node feature dimensions because it incorrectly patches lazy Linear submodules inside basis convolutions as if they were nodewise modules.
GCN, GraphSAGE, GIN, and GAT model classes are importable and passed configurable depth, out_channels, dropout, jumping-knowledge, and GAT heads shape checks.
